thread:
Devin: Quick kickoff for the 'optimizer-advisor' piece of Optimize. Goal is a lightweight advisor that surfaces batching/caching/quantization suggestions + eval-triggered alerts. Keep MVP conservative: no runtime autopilot, recommendations only plus manual apply flow. Thoughts on scope and launch gates?

Anya: Works for me. Suggest MVP scope: 1) route-level batching heuristic, 2) prefix caching recommendation, 3) quant profile recommendation (with expected quality delta), 4) eval alerting with triage payload. No autoscale or auto-apply.

Rohan: Customer constraints: NovaRetail wants per-tenant guardrails and a CSV export of examples for their compliance team. Also flagging that dedicated customers require a ticketed apply flow — we can't change reserved pools without ops approval.

Devin: Good call. We'll add a per-tenant opt-in toggle and a "create-ticket-for-apply" flag for dedicated accounts.

Priya: Acceptance criteria proposals: concordance >= 90% on recommended vs manual expert choices, median latency impact <= 5% when recommendation is applied, and recommended quant profiles should not exceed a 3% quality delta on core prompt sets. Alerts should include 50 labeled examples for the SRE/PM triage.

Maya: UX: Console card should display: estimated monthly savings, predicted p50 latency delta, confidence band, and a small preview of failing examples when alert fires. API should return a recommendation object so customers can ingest programmatically.

Devin: Example API payload we discussed (for recommendations):

```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "recommendations": [
    { "type": "batching", "suggested_batch_size": 8, "expected_tokens_saved_pct": 12.5, "confidence": 0.82 },
    { "type": "kv_cache", "suggested_prefix_length": 64, "expected_p50_latency_gain_ms": 14, "confidence": 0.74 },
    { "type": "quantization", "profile": "int8-llm", "expected_quality_delta_pct": 1.8, "confidence": 0.67 }
  ],
  "metadata": { "generated_at": "2026-03-22T17:12:00Z", "model": "redwood-3b" }
}
```

Rohan: We must be careful with the metadata fields for private deployments — can't include raw prompts or samples in payloads unless the customer opted into telemetry. Add a telemetry opt-in flag per-tenant.

Anya: Noted. Launch checklist (alpha -> pilot): 1) 2 pilot customers signed (one hosted, one dedicated), 2) docs + quickstart + Console opt-in toggle, 3) E2E tests covering batching/cache/quant paths, 4) evaluation harness with baseline prompt sets, 5) runbook for rollback and manual apply, 6) privacy review & telemetry consent.

Priya: Owners: Devin -> runtime heuristics + API schema, Rohan -> tenant/privacy/ops flow + ticketing integration, Maya -> Console UI and savings calc, Anya -> pilot outreach and docs, Priya -> eval metrics + alerting configs. Target: alpha in 3 weeks.

Devin: Risk notes: 1) over-aggressive quant suggestions could cause subtle quality regressions, 2) batching heuristics might increase tail latency for small requests, 3) mismatch between our simulated evals and customer production distributions. We'll mitigate with conservative confidence thresholds and A/B gating for pilot customers.

ops-bot: deploy planned: optimizer-advisor/alpha -> staging at 3180012399 by @ci-bot

Maya: One small ask from CS: exportable triage bundle when alert fires (examples + model context + timestamp) so they can hand to customers. Make sure it respects telemetry opt-in.

Anya: Agreed. Add triage bundle to the alerts implementation backlog and mark privacy gate as blocking for any export feature.

Devin: I'll open the tech spec PR today with API schema + minimal runtime proto. Posting links here when ready. If anyone has blockers speak up now so I can adjust the alpha target.

Priya: I'll draft the eval thresholds doc and share sample prompt sets.

Rohan: I'll coordinate ops ticket flow and get an example of the ticket payload for dedicated accounts.

Anya: Perfect. We'll consolidate these notes into a short spec and share with pilot candidates this week. Thanks everyone :rocket:
